purpose: Gen5-9 species-level presentation variant-isolation guardrails before formal BattleVariant migration

sources.title: What is the difference between Dynamax and Gigantamax Pokémon?
supports: Gigantamax capability is specimen-specific even among eligible species
ordinary or Dynamax specimens must not inherit Gigantamax investment value automatically

sources.title: What are Max Pokémon?
supports: Max Pokémon are a special type of Pokémon
Dynamax and Gigantamax capability must be represented separately from ordinary specimens

sources.title: Hisuian Braviary Raid Guide
supports: Rufflet cannot currently evolve into Hisuian Braviary in Pokémon GO
Hisuian Braviary is obtained independently via raids in the checked source

sources.title: Petilil: Best Moveset, Counters & Max CP
supports: Pokémon GO Petilil evolution chart lists ordinary Lilligant, not Hisuian Lilligant
